title: Asymptotic estimations for a nonstandard bidimensional risk model with dependent claims and constant interest force
summary: In this paper we extend the results from Yang and Li(2017), in a non-renewal driven bivariate risk model. Concretely, we are interested in the asymptotic behavior of the joint tail of the discounted aggregate claims over finite and infinite time horizon in a bivariate risk model with two arbitrarily dependent counting processes. We additionally suppose that the sequences of claim-sizes of the two lines of business are independent, but each of them contains weakly dependent terms.
